notes.title: New Demo
notes.content:
Major update
After launching the very first demo, I realized that something needed to be changed in it! All thanks to the players who made videos and shared their opinions! Thank you so much!

It's thanks to you that I FULLY redid the entire demo and story from scratch! As far as I'm concerned, I made it better! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589160/d4d190535666f72ba1c97c73b290e39af2e821fa.gif"]
New plot: 
You have money problems and decide to take a very risky gamble. An ancient tomb was found in an abandoned mine, but a group of archaeologists disappeared there and it is going to be closed! You decide to infiltrate and steal ancient artifacts to sell them on the black market!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589160/e111909739ac235d182a4d3e82b3ae66380b167f.gif"]

I hope you enjoy the new content! I tried to add more atmosphere, more interactions, and also, showed the monster as many asked for! Enjoy the game!
